label: Chassis
desc: Designs and fabricates the roll cage: tube selection, FEA, jigs and welding. Every other system bolts onto their work.

label: Powertrain
desc: Engine mounting, CVT tuning and gearbox design. They turn 10 HP into acceleration and hill-climb pace.

label: Suspension
desc: Geometry, shocks and knuckles. They decide how the car lands jumps, ruts and rocks.

label: Brakes
desc: Hydraulic system, rotors and calipers. The car must lock all four wheels at inspection, every time.

label: Electrical
desc: Kill switches, brake lights, wiring harness and the data-logging sensors we test with.

label: Manufacturing
desc: Machining, CNC, process planning and quality checks. They turn CAD into parts on time.

label: Business & Marketing
desc: Sponsorship, cost report, business presentation, social media and this website.
